caption: The drawing features a detailed rendering of a mechanical object, prominently displayed in the center and occupying most of the composition. The central object appears to be constructed mostly of metal, and consists of a round base tray with raised edges, supporting a vertical cylindrical column. Attached to the column is a curved handle, joined at an angle, and a secondary ring-shaped handle extends from the main structure. The top section of the column supports an oval-shaped housing with a flat top and a spout-like extension. Above the housing, a thin rod extends upward, curving at the top and ending in a looping coil with a smaller straight rod hanging downward. To the left of the main central object, there are three technical schematic views within a rectangle: a top-down view, a side profile with partial internal structure, and a front elevation with a ruler below indicating scale in inches (up to 6 inches). The drawing is monochromatic, executed in shades of gray with graphite or pencil, and small annotated text reads "Mildred Ford" in the lower left corner. The background is a plain, light-colored untextured surface.
title: Betty Lamp and Stamp
